name: tracelens
description: Local viewer and analytics for AI coding-agent session logs (Claude Code and Codex CLI).

scripts.demo: npm run build && node -e "fs.rmSync('.demo', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node dist/scripts/demo-data.js .demo/projects .demo/codex && node dist/src/cli.js serve --dir .demo/projects --codex-dir .demo/codex
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && TZ=UTC node --test dist/test/e2e.js
